title: Outbox/profile pages render unsanitized content_html
description: activitypub.rs:329-333,451-459. The profile_page and post_page functions render content_html directly into the HTML template without additional sanitization. The content_html was sanitized when the post was created (via ammonia in posting.rs), but posts imported from archives (import.rs:280) use ammonia::clean on the content, and remote posts stored in remote_posts also had HTML sanitized on ingest. However, the profile page at line 330 and post page at line 459 embed this content directly into the response via format!. If any code path stores unsanitized HTML in content_html, it would be rendered as-is. The trust boundary here is the DB — all writers sanitize, but this is an implicit invariant with no enforcement at the read site.
